children.name: Datasets
children.description: Datasets for gripper manipulation, including single-arm and bimanual collection. Record acquisition hardware and processing methods alongside the dataset; distinguish reported collection scale from public releases.
children.description_zh: 服务于夹爪操作学习的数据集，包括单臂和双臂采集。采集硬件与处理方法随数据集记录，区分论文报告规模和实际公开范围。

children.name: Benchmarks
children.description: Dexterous-hand evaluation tasks, data, environments, and protocols. Distinguish published support from demonstrated configurations.
children.description_zh: 灵巧手操作评测任务、数据、环境与评分协议；区分论文声明、公开资产和实际评测配置。

children.name: Video Demonstrations to Robot Actions
children.name_zh: 视频示范到机器人动作
children.description: Recover manipulation from real or generated videos and convert it into executable dexterous robot actions. Record scene assumptions and physical refinement; distinguish trajectory replay from closed-loop policy deployment. Retargeting and RL are method tags, not automatic inclusion criteria.
children.description_zh: 从真实或生成视频恢复操作过程，转换为可执行的灵巧机器人动作。记录场景假设与物理修正方式，区分轨迹回放和闭环策略部署；重定向、RL 等作为方法标签，不因使用某项技术就自动归入本类。

children.name: Reinforcement Learning
children.description: Reinforcement learning for in-hand rotation, repositioning and coordinated object manipulation. Record sensing, demonstrations, sim-to-real techniques and evaluated objects as tags or evaluation scope; using RL in a demonstration-conversion pipeline alone does not place a work here.
children.description_zh: 以强化学习获得手内旋转、重定位及物体协同操作策略。感知方式、示范利用、仿真到真机技术和已验证物体用标签与评测范围记录；仅在示范转换流程中使用 RL，不自动归入本类。

children.name: Execution Feedback and Correction
children.description: Execution feedback, action correction and recovery for dexterous-hand VLA systems. Distinguish changes to executed commands, subsequent policy observations and model parameters; record sensing and task scenarios as tags.
children.description_zh: 面向灵巧手 VLA 的执行反馈、动作纠正与失败恢复。区分对执行指令、后续策略观测和模型参数的影响；感知方式与验证任务用标签记录。

children.name: Execution Efficiency and Temporal Control
children.description: Methods for faster task execution through action timing, temporal granularity and scheduling across manipulation platforms. Record evaluated backbones and embodiments; distinguish execution speed from model inference latency.
children.description_zh: 通过动作节奏、时间粒度与调度提高任务执行效率的操作共性方法。记录已验证基座与本体，区分动作执行加速和模型推理加速。

children.name: Navigation Action Models
children.description: Includes point-goal, object-goal, and language-guided navigation, exploration, and navigation trajectory generation. The focus is reaching or finding a target using environmental observations; locomotion execution can be linked as a related area.
children.description_zh: 包括点目标导航、物体目标导航、语言导航、探索与导航轨迹生成。重点是利用环境观测到达或找到目标；涉及行走执行时，可关联身体运动与全身控制板块。

children.name: Body Motion and Whole-Body Control Models
children.name_zh: 身体运动与全身控制模型
children.description: Includes locomotion, balance, motion tracking, getting up, dynamic motor skills, and coordinated body control. Loco-manipulation belongs here when body coordination, balance, or motion execution is the main research question; manipulation can be noted as a related area.
children.description_zh: 包括行走、平衡、动作跟踪、起身、复杂运动技能与身体协同控制。行走操作以身体协同、平衡或动作执行为主要研究问题时归入本类，并可关联操作板块。
